frames: every picture and three frames of every clip; evaluated in the vision call shared with the place check

questions.question: Does the room hold the crowd its state gives, to within the state's range?
questions.major_when: the beat's crowd state is full and the room is empty or near empty (fewer than half the state's minimum people)

questions.question: Is the choir the right number, in the right place, in any shot that shows the whole loft?
questions.major_when: the choir is under half or over double the stated headcount

questions.question: Is this the same room: size, layout, fixed things?
questions.major_when: the frame is a lip-sync picture whose place is not the place its beat names

questions.question: Are the room's set pieces there?
questions.major_when: the room reads as another room

questions.question: Does the light and the window fit the beat's time of day?
questions.major_when: it contradicts the story (night outside a morning scene)
